response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in full-stack and embedded development, but lacks direct experience with embedded networking, Linux kernel modifications, C programming for UNIX environments, or Japanese language proficiency—key requirements for this role. Their background in web and mobile development does not align closely enough with the embedded firmware and security features focus of the position.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and frameworks
Proven ability to work on embedded systems (e.g., robotic arms, mobile device orchestration)
Open source contributions and project leadership demonstrate technical depth
concerns: No evidence of C programming for UNIX or embedded environments
No mention of Linux kernel investigation or modification
Lacks Japanese language proficiency, which is a required qualification
